bullets: Fixed: A clinic whose items are all non-controllable today (for example, only Authorization Missing) no longer disappears. It stays in the Location and Clinics pickers with (0), and the recap email lists it with 0.
Changed: The Dev Update bell now shows only in full screen, right of the IR Portal Tracker name at the top left. It is gone from the side pane.
Changed: A red dot on the bell means something new. Nothing pops up any more: click the bell to read it, and the dot clears.
Changed: You can still drag the bell away; drop it near its spot and it goes back.
Changed: The sun and moon on the light/dark button are whole again.
Changed: The Dev Update bell floats again. Drag it anywhere; it starts at the bottom right.
Changed: Light/dark shows half of each symbol with a slash between them.
New: The first time you open the IR Portal Tracker each day, it asks for your name. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. To change it, use Switch user next to Location.
Changed: Notes, reclassifications and provider changes now record the name you picked, not the email sign-off name.
New: While the workbook is read, a loading screen shows each step.
New: This bell, at the end of the toolbar, shows what changed in the tracker. Every toolbar button names what it does when you hover over it, and light/dark mode shows as sun / moon.
